name: Burning Swings adds 4 additional attacks to Burning Blade (#1019, trikyn-live-ops#32)
contract: Burning Swings 707632 reads 'Your Burning Blade now affects $s1 additional attacks.' Effect 0 is native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), EffectMiscValue 4 -> SpellModOp::SPELLMOD_CHARGES (src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h:80), EffectBasePoints 3 with DieSides 1 -> 4, EffectSpellClassMask [256,0,0] (all verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc). The affected spell is Burning Blade 524920 (the weapon-imbue buff with native ProcCharges 6, SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL triggering the damage spell 524919, 'Lasts for $n attacks'): its own SpellFamilyFlags are {256,0,0}, which intersects Burning Swings' classMask exactly on dword0 bit 8. The client renders $n with the player's SPELLMOD_CHARGES applied, so the tooltip promises 6 + 4 = 10. Burning Blade is NOT purely native: it carries a spell_proc row (rev_20260909_07_knight_of_xoroth_completion.sql) whose Charges column defaults to 0, and Aura::CalcMaxCharges overwrites the DBC ProcCharges with that 0 unconditionally, so the native counter seeds at 0 + 4 = 4. It is also driven by CoA scripts (AscensionXorothAuras.cpp, AscensionXorothEvents.cpp), which keep a second charge counter in a script value. Both counters gate on the same CheckProc-filtered events, so whichever reaches zero first removes the aura. The apply handler must therefore fold SPELLMOD_CHARGES into the script counter AND re-seed the native counter, or the two disagree and the smaller one wins. spell_modifier submits no cast; it reads the player's live ApplySpellMod(spell, op, value) result. aura_charges reads the live Aura::GetCharges() of the applied aura, which is what the player actually gets.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: no charge bonus on Burning Blade before Burning Swings
Apply Burning Blade without Burning Swings
Let the aura apply handler seed the charges
CONTRACT: without Burning Swings Burning Blade carries its 6 base attacks
Clear Burning Blade before the talent case
Force the Burning Swings passive aura
SETUP: the Burning Swings passive is active
CONTRACT: Burning Blade gains 4 additional charges
Apply Burning Blade with Burning Swings active
Let the aura apply handler seed the charges
CONTRACT: with Burning Swings Burning Blade carries 10 attacks, matching its tooltip
REGRESSION: learning Burning Swings never lowers the attack count below the 6 base
REGRESSION: an unrelated family spell is untouched
